title: Spot Watchlist
howToAdd: Edit public/data/watchlist.json (add a ticker object with status, levels, thesis) OR open a GitHub issue / tell Chief of Staff. Also append a first history row for that day.
howToDrop: Move the ticker from watchlist.json into dropped.json with droppedDate, lastPrice, and reason. Append a history row with status Dropped for that day. Commit and push — the next Pages deploy picks it up.
disclaimer: Research / personal tracking only — not investment advice.
